constraints.text: Claim only checks that actually ran. Record real results in docs/installation.md before claiming them.
Keep the owner-approval and local-first message intact. The rewrite simplifies wording, not the safety rules.
The animated hero needs Aseprite 1.3+ installed and the aseprite-ai-artist extension, which are not on this Mac yet. The static hero does not depend on it.

nonGoals: Publishing to npm or the Obsidian community plugin directory is a separate decision.
No new product features in this plan.
No Show HN or Reddit launch yet. That waits for the owner's own Obsidian usage recording and an animation of what happens in the background, done later.

outcomes.criterion: The owner sees the static hero at the top of the README on GitHub in light and dark mode and approves it.
outcomes.statement: The README opens with a static MOZAK hero icon that matches the Obsidian plugin's brain icon and the gold, purple, green palette, readable in GitHub light and dark mode.

outcomes.criterion: The owner watches the exported animation on the README page on GitHub and approves it.
outcomes.statement: An animated pixel-art version of the hero is made with the Aseprite AI Artist skill (/aseprite:studio) and exported as a GIF the README can show alongside or instead of the static icon.

outcomes.criterion: The owner reads the new README top to bottom and approves it as understandable for a first-time reader.
outcomes.statement: The README explains what MOZAK is, who it is for and how to start in plain words, with the first screen answering 'what is this and why would I use it'.

outcomes.criterion: Every command and requirement in the README matches the current code and docs/installation.md, and each command shown runs as written on a Mac with Node 26.
outcomes.statement: The README describes today's features correctly: Node 24.11 or newer including 26, remote scopes by GitHub URL, and the Obsidian plugin.

outcomes.criterion: The owner reviews the list of fixed and documented gaps and agrees it is enough to publish.
outcomes.statement: Known gaps that would mislead a new user are fixed or stated honestly: docs/installation.md still says macOS install is unverified although it ran on this Mac on 2026-10-14, and the installer has no upgrade path, so a new version needs a fresh prefix.

content.purpose: Get MOZAK ready to look good on GitHub: a static hero icon and an animated pixel-art hero at the top of the README, a README a first-time reader understands in one pass, and the small fixes that would mislead a new user. Show HN and Reddit come later, after the owner records a real Obsidian usage video.
content.rationale: The owner wants MOZAK to look good on GitHub first. The current README hero is an animated architecture GIF and the text is dense, and some statements are out of date after the 2026-10-14 work on Node 26, remote scopes and the plugin. Owner answers on 2026-10-14: static hero plus an animated pixel version, GitHub only for now.
